eslint.copilot_role: get_errors provides inline diagnostics; fix-lint prompt auto-fixes; run_task triggers workspace lint
eslint.token_hint: Prefer get_errors over running eslint in terminal when checking a single file

prettier.copilot_role: Format-on-save ensures code output matches project style without extra tool calls

vitest.copilot_role: run_task '🔬 Vitest: Run All Tests' or '🔬 Vitest: Current File' preferred over raw npx vitest
vitest.token_hint: Use run_task for test execution; testFailure deferred tool for inline failure context

playwright.copilot_role: E2E test runner via run_task '🎭 Playwright: E2E Tests'; MCP playwright server for in-chat browser automation
playwright.token_hint: Use view_image on test-results/ screenshots to diagnose VR failures

gitlens.copilot_role: Git blame/history via GitKraken MCP; supplements vscode_listCodeUsages with change attribution

github-actions.copilot_role: Workflow YAML validation, auto-complete for action inputs, inline run status

webhint.copilot_role: Browser compat warnings in get_errors; validates .browserslistrc compliance inline

spell-checker.copilot_role: Hebrew + English spell-check diagnostics surfaced via get_errors on markdown files

todo-tree.copilot_role: Tracks TODO/FIXME/HACK comments; useful for dead-code sweeps and pre-release audits

stylelint.copilot_role: CSS diagnostics in get_errors; enforces layer order, custom-property usage, no hardcoded colors

markdownlint.copilot_role: Markdown diagnostics via get_errors; run_task '📝 Markdownlint: Docs' for full sweep

edge-devtools.copilot_role: Lighthouse/axe integration; supplements LHCI CI checks for local preview

powershell.copilot_role: Terminal profile + script debugging; all run_in_terminal commands execute in PowerShell
powershell.token_hint: Never emit Unix commands — settings.json pins 'PowerShell Fast' as default profile

git-graph.copilot_role: Visual branch/commit explorer; supplements gitkraken MCP blame/log for branch topology questions

editorconfig.copilot_role: Auto-applies .editorconfig on save — no formatting corrections needed from Copilot
editorconfig.token_hint: File formatting is handled automatically; never add whitespace/eol fixups to edits

html-css.copilot_role: CSS class/ID completion in HTML; reduces need for semantic_search on style references
html-css.token_hint: User gets inline suggestions — Copilot can assume class names are valid if in src/styles/

coverage-gutters.copilot_role: Displays coverage inline from lcov.info after vitest --coverage. Toggle Watch in status bar.
coverage-gutters.token_hint: Direct user to 'Watch' mode after running coverage — no need to re-read lcov.info manually

error-lens.copilot_role: Shows all diagnostics inline in the editor — ESLint, TypeScript, Stylelint, webhint, spell-check. User sees errors immediately.
error-lens.token_hint: User already sees inline errors — get_errors confirms what user sees without terminal round-trip

console-ninja.copilot_role: Inline console/diagLog output in editor during debugging. User sees values without switching to terminal.
console-ninja.token_hint: For debugging data flow issues, user can read inline values — Copilot doesn't need to add temporary console.log

baseline-lens.copilot_role: Inline CSS/JS Baseline availability annotations. Shows browser compat status next to CSS properties.
baseline-lens.token_hint: Supplements webhint — Copilot can assume user is informed about compat status before asking

version-lens.copilot_role: Shows latest vs installed package versions inline in package.json. User sees outdated deps at a glance.
version-lens.token_hint: No need to run npm outdated in terminal — user already sees version badges inline

bookmarks.copilot_role: Mark and navigate key code locations. Useful for debugging complex card/adapter chains across files.

mermaid-chart.copilot_role: Mermaid diagram preview in markdown files. Validates architecture diagrams in docs/.

drawio.copilot_role: Draw.io diagram editing. SVGs in .github/assets/ can be edited visually.

caniuse.copilot_role: Quick Can I Use lookup for CSS/JS features. Supplements webhint for specific feature queries.
caniuse.token_hint: Use fetch_webpage on caniuse.com only when extension lookup is insufficient

svg-preview.copilot_role: SVG preview and editing. Use view_image on SVG files in .github/assets/ for visual inspection.

browserslist.copilot_role: Syntax highlighting and validation for .browserslistrc. Ensures browser targets are valid.

rules: Instructions use applyTo globs — only loaded when relevant files are edited
Skills auto-discovered by description — invoke read_file only when skill matches
Agents delegate via handoffs — avoid re-explaining domain rules in prompts
run_task preferred over run_in_terminal for workspace-defined commands (20 tasks defined)
runTests preferred over terminal vitest for test validation after edits
get_errors preferred over running lint/tsc in terminal for single-file checks
get_errors surfaces ESLint + Stylelint + webhint + markdownlint + spell-check diagnostics in one call
tool_search once per MCP tool family — broad queries reduce round-trips
multi_replace_string_in_file for batch edits — single tool call vs N sequential
search_subagent for multi-file exploration — faster than sequential file_search/grep_search
runSubagent for multi-step tasks — keeps main context clean and focused
memory repo scope for frequently-referenced facts — avoids repeated lookups
Deferred tools stay unloaded until needed — never eagerly load all MCP tools
EditorConfig + Prettier format-on-save eliminate formatting fixups from edits
PowerShell profile pins 'PowerShell Fast' (-NoLogo) — never suggest bash alternatives
Error Lens shows errors inline — user already sees diagnostics, so confirm rather than re-explain
Coverage Gutters shows uncovered lines — point user to Watch mode instead of parsing lcov.info
Console Ninja shows diagLog() inline — no need to add temp logging for debugging
Version Lens shows outdated deps inline — skip npm outdated terminal calls
Baseline Lens shows CSS compat inline — supplements webhint without extra tool calls
Color Highlight reveals hardcoded colors inline — skip grepping for hex values
TODO Tree tracks TODO/FIXME locations — skip grepping for TODO comments
Hooks: PreToolUse guards duplicate files, bad context, terminal misuse, rename without usages, parallel semantic_search
Hooks: PostToolUse auto-reminds RTL/CSS/cache/dialog conventions + checks exit codes after terminal
read_file large ranges (50+ lines) over many small reads — fewer round-trips
Parallel independent reads — read multiple files in same turn when possible
grep_search with alternation (word1|word2) — single search for multiple patterns
vscode_listCodeUsages before removing exports — prevents breaking references
view_image for VR screenshots — visual inspection over guessing at layout issues
